thread:
maria: Heads-up — Acme Inc (acct ACME-42) is blocked on INV-2026-0042. Card declined when we tried to charge; customer uploaded a PO (PO-9142) and is asking for Net60. They're asking us to release the invoice so procurement can process. Screenshot of decline attached.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0042 created automatically. Charge attempt failed: `do_not_honor`. No automatic retries configured.

sam (acct exec): Customer says procurement requires the PO on file + signed SOW and W-9. They want Net60, not prepay.

dan (finance): Before we give Net60 we need vendor validation + tax info. Does Acme have an EU VAT ID? If not, we'll need to apply tax. Also check for prior chargebacks.

maria: Repro steps I performed in Console: Admin > Billing > Invoices > INV-2026-0042 > click 'Release with Net Terms' -> modal shows 'Awaiting approvals' and the spinner never finishes. Browser console shows API 403 on POST /api/approvals/submit with payload `{ "invoice": "INV-2026-0042", "terms": "Net60" }`. Error: ```403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "approval_not_authorized",
  "detail": "org not in approved-vendors"
}```

dan (finance): That looks like the approvals service is preventing release because Acme isn't on the approved-vendors list. We can either whitelist them (longer) or do a provisional manual release. I can do a manual ledger entry and mark `manual_net_terms_release` if legal signs off.

jen (legal): We can approve provisional Net60 with a simple addendum attaching the PO and W-9. I'll need the customer's legal contact and the exact billing address. Draft will be quick.

sam (acct exec): Legal contact is Olivia Patel <olivia.p@acme.com>. I'll upload the signed PO and SOW to the ticket now. VAT: customer said they are UK-based with VAT ID GB999999973.

dan (finance): OK if VAT ID is valid we treat as B2B within UK, no VAT charged on our invoice (reverse charge), but need that ID on file. I'll run vendor lookup and check risk flags. If clear, I'll do a one-time manual release and set due date +60 days.

maria: Action items: @dan - vendor check + manual release if clean; @jen - prepare addendum; @sam - confirm PO + W-9 upload and paste link. I'll pause escalation while we collect docs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam (acct exec): Uploaded `PO-9142_signed.pdf` and `W9_ACME.pdf` to the shared folder: https://drive.internal/Acme/PO-9142.

dan (finance): Verified VAT GB999999973 via EU VAT checker, no flags on vendor history. I created ledger note `manual_net_terms_release:1809876543` and set payment terms to Net60 (due date 2026-06-17). Releasing invoice now.

maria: Done — I released INV-2026-0042 manually and updated the invoice status to `Sent (Net60, provisional)`. Notified customer message: "We've released your invoice on provisional Net60 pending signed SOW & W-9 (received). Please confirm receipt." :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: System log: `invoice_release: INV-2026-0042, method: manual, note: manual_net_terms_release, initiated_by: dan`

jen (legal): I'll attach the addendum and request the customer's sign-off. Once signed, we can remove the provisional flag and complete the approval flow so future releases work via the portal.

maria: Closing loop — customer notified and finance has set terms. If the approvals API keeps rejecting for this org we should file a ticket with infra to add a clear error and remediation steps. Filing: #infra-approvals -> pinging infra after this thread. :spiral_notepad:
